description: This file defines the SearchResults class which encapsulates search result data and related operations for the SuiteCRM system. It manages search hits, scoring, display formatting, and related bean retrieval within the SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: SearchResults
classes.description: Handles search results, including fetching beans, formatting display data, and managing search metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes SearchResults with hits, grouping, timing, total counts, scores, and options.

methods.name: getHitsAsBeans
methods.description: Fetches search hits as SuiteCRM bean objects, repairing index if beans are missing.

methods.name: formatForDisplay
methods.description: Formats bean fields for display, handling enum, multienum, and currency types.

methods.name: updateFieldDefLinks
methods.description: Updates link-related fields in a bean for display.

methods.name: updateObjLinks
methods.description: Updates related record links within a bean for display purposes.

methods.name: getRelatedId
methods.description: Resolves the related record ID for a bean relationship.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Constructs an HTML link for a given label, module, record ID, and action.

methods.name: getScores
methods.description: Returns the scoring data for hits.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total number of search hits.

methods.name: getModuleTotal
methods.description: Returns total hits for a specific module.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Returns specific search option by key.

methods.name: getSearchTime
methods.description: Returns the time taken to perform the search.

methods.name: isGroupedByModule
methods.description: Indicates whether hits are grouped by module.

methods.name: getLargestHitsCount
methods.description: Returns the largest number of hits among modules.
